title: Current-Canonical Postimage Reconciliation after F-CI50
purpose: Advance only the moving current-canonical preservation authority to the F-CI50 postimage and add the newly admitted typed groundwater-interface source paths to the preservation surface.
hard_guards: No src/ or reference/ file may change in F-CI50P.
The F-CI50 postimage must be a true two-parent merge of the frozen prepromotion canonical and exact qualified F-CI50 status head.
Both F-GC17 source blobs must remain exact.
The historical/frozen prefix of fci-canonical.yml must remain byte-identical.
The moving-preservation suffix may change only by the exact authority replacement, two dependency-path insertions and one F-CI50 marker insertion.
Mass conservation, tolerances, physics, solver behavior and transaction behavior may not change.
promotion_rule: After exact-head qualification, promote only if integration/f-ci-canonical still equals the F-CI50 postimage, using a true two-parent governance-only merge and no force update.
